about_the_game:
🎭 Simple Yet Dramatic Rhythm Gameplay

Just tap to the beat, follow the rhythm, and complete the challenge! Sounds easy? Think again. Every note comes with an unexpected twist that will shatter your expectations! 🤯💥

🎮 Pure rhythm & mad vibes
Every level gets crazier than the last—a brain-busting challenge that keeps you hooked and laughing out loud.

🎨 Hand-drawn art & vibrant characters
Each character brings their own over-the-top “rhythm life” with wild expressions and moves that leave a lasting impression.

👥 Brand-new crew on deck
20+ unique characters are coming soon— from cool, razor-tongued types to clumsy daredevils, each with their own killer rhythm move.

🚪 Check into Rhythm Hotel now
Kick off your rhythmic adventure—swing by anytime. What happens next? Only the beat knows.

short_description: Rhythm Hotel is open! Grab your camera and capture Einstein’s secret identity! Next door, Socrates is in a heated debate with a stubborn donkey. Don’t panic! It’s our special rhythm challenge — fall behind the beat and you might get kicked into a dimensional rift by the donkey!
